title: SIG-16 income derivation on team members' own grants (Stage A, the first real-data experiment)
status: pre-registered before any team data is ingested or scored; not to be edited after the first team grant is ingested. A change after that is a new pre-registration on a new population.
hypothesis: H1 Serviceability. Grouping recurring credits by normalised payer name and cadence (weekly, fortnightly, monthly), excluding own-account transfers, refunds, loan disbursements and wage advances, will derive net monthly income within 5% of the verified figure for salaried applicants with at least 3 months of history, because salary credits are regular in both timing and amount.
metric: absolute percentage error of derived against ground-truth net monthly income (scoring harness, run record schema 1.0.0)

classification.supported: primary run share within 5% >= 0.90, with the negative control passing
classification.refuted: primary run share within 5% < 0.80, with the negative control passing
classification.inconclusive: 0.80 <= share < 0.90, or the negative control fails, or the data cannot test the claim

method.credits_considered: positive amounts in transaction and savings accounts (CDR productCategory TRANS_AND_SAVINGS_ACCOUNTS, or no category) inside the lookback window ending on as_of
exclusions: own-account transfers: a narrative carrying a BSB and account number; or a credit matched by a debit of the same amount on the same day in another shared account
refunds and reversals: narratives containing REFUND, REVERSAL or CASHBACK
loan disbursements and advances: narratives containing LOAN or ADVANCE
wage-advance and BNPL providers: BEFOREPAY, MYPAYNOW, CASHD, AFTERPAY, ZIP PAY, ZIP MONEY, HUMM, KLARNA
card and loan repayments received: PAYMENT RECEIVED, REPAYMENT RECEIVED
method.payer_normalisation: upper case; digits and punctuation removed; whitespace collapsed
method.stream_rule: a group is a stream when it has at least min_occurrences credits in the window and its median gap falls in a cadence band; other groups are not income
method.monthly_equivalent: median credit amount x 52/12 (weekly), 26/12 (fortnightly) or 1 (monthly), per AF-I1; streams are summed
method.enrich: not used: the hypothesis groups by payer name, and the engine imports nothing outside src/engines (D3). The ticket's control 'Enrich taxonomy 1.3' therefore does not apply to this run

engine_amendments: 2026-11-10, before any team grant is ingested or scored: the GR-3 gate moved from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0 (SIG-42 review 9, C3: a liability-category credit carrying a sensitive MCC is now removed). Observed income 1.0.1's output over synthetic set v1 is byte-identical at both gates (test/engines/affordability/gate-replay.test.ts). Nothing else in this registration changes

negative_control.name: shuffled payer names
negative_control.manipulation: every credit narrative is replaced with a name unique to that credit, spelt in letters only (PAYER followed by the credit's index within the applicant in base 26, A to Z), destroying payer grouping while keeping amounts and dates
negative_control.amendment: 2026-11-07, before any run: the first registration used PAYER <transactionId>, which payer normalisation (digits removed) would have collapsed into one group; the names are now letters only
negative_control.expected: share within 5% below 0.20; if it is 0.20 or more, the grouping is not what drives the result and no other result in the set stands
negative_control.on_this_data: run first on the same team grants, before the primary configuration is scored

data.consent_record: SIG-61 comment 40194: openfeed's flow captures a disclosure consent to the app, under the Privacy Act, and no de-identification consent
data.kept_for_research: nothing: each person's data is used for their own assessment and this comparison with their declared truths, then purged (Colin, 10:50 on 9 November 2026); at the latest 30 days after connection (RETENTION_DAYS, a candidate)
data.purpose_requirement: the purpose each person agrees to names the comparison with their declared figures (openfeed developer terms cl 4.1); a person whose consent record has another purpose version is excluded
data.where: the secure environment only (ADR 0008); nothing real enters the repository, CI or run records

truth.note: net monthly truth = payslip.net_per_pay x the factor for pay_cadence, per AF-I1, the same conversion the engine uses

population.who: team members who connect through openfeed production and complete truth capture 2.0.0 with payslip_verified true
population.inclusion: salaried (a pay_cadence other than irregular), at least 3 months of history in the grant, the account the pay goes into in the grant
population.exclusion: anyone who revokes before scoring (purged, not scored); anyone whose consent record has another purpose version
population.below_minimum: inconclusive: the data cannot test the claim; the counts are reported and nothing else
population.as_of: the day before each person's connection, as ingestion reads it

reporting.outputs: counts and rates only, through the T2 guard, written under realdata/ in the secure environment: people scored, people within 5%, the share within, the negative control's share, and the classification
reporting.small_cell_rule: no count or rate is reported for a group of fewer than 5 people; such a group is reported as fewer than 5
reporting.no_amounts: no income figure, error amount or per-person error is reported, only whether each person was within 5%, counted
reporting.where_results_go: the SIG-16 ticket and the hypothesis page Results log, as counts and rates

no_tuning: no parameter, exclusion word, cadence band or threshold may change after any team data is seen. Any change is a new pre-registration on a new population, and this one is reported as run.
order: 1. this pre-registration is committed and pinned by its SHA-256 before the first team grant is ingested
2. the negative control is run on the team grants and recorded
3. the primary configuration is run and recorded
4. the variables grid is run and recorded
5. each person's data is purged; the deletion receipts are recorded
known_limits: a team of 10 to 20 people is small: a share within 5% has a wide interval (for 15 people, 13 of 15 within has a 95% Clopper-Pearson interval of about 0.60 to 0.98), so the result is reported with its interval
team members are not a sample of applicants: likely salaried, single-employer and paid into one bank
the payslip is one pay; a person whose pay varies (overtime, a bonus) may differ from the payslip in a month without the method being wrong
the truth is self-declared from a payslip the person has; nobody else checks it
